column1: # Open-class stems, bulk-loaded into %lex Root via `%import lexicon.tsv`.
# The stem is consonant-final for -а feminines and bare masculines (собак, журнал),
# and the paradigm supplies the endings. Gender comes from the paradigm (N-fem-a /
# N-masc-hard / N-neut-o); animacy is a per-stem feature on the masculine rows
# (<anim>=anim|inan), since it selects the accusative allomorph and cross-cuts the
# declension. So a feminine/neuter row adds only <lemma>, a masculine row adds
# Future: the seed sticks to regular stems whose nominative plural is the productive
# -ы/-а. Stems with irregular plurals (дом -> дома, брат -> братья, город -> города)
# are kept singular here; soft-sign and -ь stems (день, мать) want their own paradigms.
# --- Nouns: masculine hard stem, animate (acc = gen, -а) ----------------------
# --- Nouns: masculine hard stem, inanimate (acc = nom) ------------------------
# Valency is lexical (it picks who may take a direct object), not a property of the
# conjugation: транзитивные читать/знать/... vs intransitive работать/гулять/играть.
